steps.name: Assess
steps.desc: Understand the work. Map the current workflow, systems, constraints and people involved. Agree the problem before choosing a solution.

steps.name: Prioritize
steps.desc: Choose a useful next step. Compare opportunities by value, feasibility and dependencies. Agree a baseline and what success would mean.

steps.name: Validate
steps.desc: Test the important assumptions with a prototype or a focused pilot, compare results with a baseline and decide what deserves further investment.

steps.name: Deliver
steps.desc: Build around the real workflow. Design and engineer in reviewable increments, and test integrations, exceptions and the user experience before rollout.

steps.name: Adopt
steps.desc: Prepare for everyday use. Document operation and ownership, support the handover and agree how to measure and improve the system.
